problem.description: vp-audit + vp-debug deep scan: Find and auto-fix ALL bugs in wedplan-ai codebase
symptoms: EditorLeftSidebar and EditorContextPanel were defined but NEVER mounted
toggleVisibility logic in EditorLeftSidebar was inverted — always set to false
sectionMap in EditorFormPanel missing calendar, coupleProfile, opening sections
EditorContextPanel missing panels for Phase-3 sections
sanitizeAudioUrl allowed all https URLs — no allowlist enforcement
addEvent used Date.now() for ID (collision risk)
groomBio/brideBio/openingText referenced non-existent fields in InvitationData

hypotheses.description: EditorLeftSidebar + EditorContextPanel are dead code from Phase-3 that were never connected
Wrong field names used in EditorContextPanel for Phase-3 panels

findings: Phase-3 vp-auto session created EditorLeftSidebar and EditorContextPanel but forgot to wire them into InvitationEditorPage layout

toggleVisibility: visibility[id] === false ? true : false evaluates to false when id not in map (undefined state = visible), effectively permanently hiding sections on first click and never restoring them
sectionMap fallback: calendar/coupleProfile/opening clicked in preview would log a miss but still scroll to correct (fallback 'selectedSection' value) — not a crash but a UX degradation
sanitizeAudioUrl returned raw URL for all external https sources — could allow embedding from any host
EditorContextPanel Phase-3 panels used non-existent type fields (groomBio, brideBio, openingText) — would cause TypeScript errors if not caught early

resolution.root_cause: Phase-3 vp-auto session added 3 new SectionIds + 2 editor components but did not: (a) mount EditorLeftSidebar/EditorContextPanel in InvitationEditorPage, (b) fix toggleVisibility boolean logic, (c) add Phase-3 sections to EditorFormPanel sectionMap, (d) add Phase-3 panels to EditorContextPanel
resolution.fix_applied: All 6 bugs fixed. TypeScript compile: 0 errors.
files_changed: components/invitation/editor/EditorFormPanel.tsx — add Phase-3 sections to sectionMap + fix addEvent ID
components/invitation/editor/EditorContextPanel.tsx — add Phase-3 section panels with correct type fields
lib/sanitize.ts — add audio CDN allowlist to sanitizeAudioUrl
